==English==

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:af|buy|-er<id:agent noun>|text=+|tree=1}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈbaɪ.ə/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈbaɪ.əɹ/|a=GA}}
* {{rhymes|en|aɪə(ɹ)|s=2}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-buyer.ogg|a=US}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# A person who makes one or more [[purchase]]s.
#: {{syn|en|purchaser|vendee}}
#: {{hyper|en|procurer|obtainer|<|person}}
#: {{ux|en|Every person who steps through the door is a potential '''buyer''', so acknowledge their presence.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2021|author=Michelle Seiler Tucker; Sharon Lechter|title=Exit Rich: The 6 P Method to Sell Your Business for Huge Profit|publisher=Greenleaf Book Group|isbn=9781732510296|text=As we covered in the last chapter, breaches of confidentiality can stop a sale dead in its tracks. To avoid this, our firm plays good cop–bad cop with '''buyers''' about confidentiality. The good cop nicely explains that breaching confidentiality is bad, because it will ruin the business they're buying before they’ve even bought it. The bad cop puts the fear of God into them, telling them that if they breach confidentiality, the seller could file a lawsuit against them, {{...}}}}
## {{senseid|en|Q7260944}} {{lb|en|often|specifically}} A [[purchasing agent#English:_Q7260944|purchasing agent]].
##: {{syn|en|purchaser<id:Q7260944>}}
### {{lb|en|[[retail]]}} A person who [[purchase]]s [[item]]s (usually in bulk) for [[resale]] in a [[retail]] establishment.
###: {{ux|en|The supermarket's new '''buyer''' decided to stock a larger range of vegetarian foods.}}
### {{lb|en|manufacturing}} A person who purchases items [[consume]]d or used as [[component]]s in the [[manufacture]] of products.
###: {{ux|en|One of the secrets to our [[wholesaling]] success is that we know what '''buyers''' will need and we make their job easy for them.}}
